policy.title: Conservative negative-quirk treatment priorities
policy.disclaimer: Priorities are editorial guidance, not values supplied by the game. They favor preventing forced interactions, permanent loot loss, and critical combat stat penalties (Speed, Accuracy, Max HP); party composition and campaign resources can change the best choice.

reasons: Forces interactions with Treasure curios.
Loot taken during the forced interaction is permanently lost.
notes: Treat immediately before the quirk becomes locked in the Sanitarium.

reasons: Forces interactions with any category of curio (20% chance).
Triggers hazardous curios without cleansing items, inflicting severe stress, blights, or negative quirks.
notes: Top-tier removal priority along with Compulsive and Kleptomaniac.

reasons: Forces interactions with any category of curio (20% chance).
Frequently triggers traps, diseases, and stress from unfiltered curio contact.
notes: Eliminate early to prevent uncontrollable curio outcomes.

reasons: Forces interactions with any category of curio with an exceptionally high 27.5% chance.
Renders party curio management chaotic and highly dangerous.
notes: Acquired from the Shrieker; prioritize Sanitarium treatment immediately.

reasons: Forces interactions with Unholy curios.
Interactions frequently cause immense stress bursts and direct damage.
notes: Especially hazardous in the Ruins and Cove where Eldritch/Unholy altars reside.

reasons: Forces interactions with Drink curios.
Frequently inflicts blights, diseases, and severe alcohol debuffs.
notes: Critical in the Warrens where moonshine barrels and tainted vats are common.

reasons: Inflicts a permanent -4 Speed penalty.
Speed dictates turn order; acting after enemy stress-dealers drastically increases incoming party damage.
notes: Treat promptly on damage dealers, stunners, and healers.

reasons: Reduces Speed by 4 and Dodge by 5 during round one.
Round one is critical for neutralizing priority threats before they act.
notes: Severe handicap for openers, stunners, and high-tempo attackers.

reasons: Inflicts a permanent -5 Accuracy penalty across all combat skills.
Missed attacks waste valuable actions and prevent enemy elimination.
notes: High priority on all primary damage dealers and stunners.

reasons: Reduces maximum HP by 10%.
Significantly lowers burst survivability and increases risk of reaching Death's Door.
notes: Especially perilous on squishy heroes like Grave Robber, Plague Doctor, and Occultist.

reasons: Inflicts a permanent -5 Dodge penalty.
Reduces effective avoidance against high-damage attacks and enemy control skills.
notes: Hurts dodge-reliant frontline and agile heroes.

reasons: Reduces melee accuracy by 5.
Severely degrades hit consistency for frontline physical attackers.
notes: Critical flaw on classes with already low base accuracy such as Leper and Crusader.

reasons: Reduces ranged accuracy by 5.
Causes vital backline snipers to miss priority enemy stress casters.
notes: High removal priority on Arbalest, Musketeer, and Highwayman.

reasons: Increases all incoming stress damage by 10%.
Accelerates affliction checks and increases party stress management costs.
notes: Treat early to maintain sanity resilience on long expeditions.

reasons: Forces interactions with Torture curios (Iron Maiden, Rack, etc.).
Torture curios carry severe bleed, tetanus, and high stress risks.
notes: Hazardous in the Ruins and Weald.

reasons: Forces interactions with Body curios (graves, corpses, remains).
High probability of contracting debilitating diseases and negative quirks.
notes: Frequent hazard in the Warrens and Weald.

reasons: Forces interactions with Reflective curios.
Loot taken during the interaction is permanently lost.
notes: Risk factor for loot evaporation.

reasons: Forces interactions with Treasure curios.
May trigger unlocked chests or bags and waste valuable party loot.
notes: Similar to Kleptomaniac, though less frequently lethal.

reasons: Forces interactions with Treasure curios.
Can forfeit keys or trigger trapped chests without disarming tools.
notes: Prevents safe item-assisted treasure harvesting.

reasons: Reduces melee skill damage by 10%.
Lowers burst potential on melee damage dealers.
notes: Prioritize on frontline bruisers; harmless on pure backline casters.

reasons: Reduces ranged critical strike chance by 3%.
Reduces burst elimination chance on ranged damage dealers.
notes: Noticeable damage penalty for snipers like Arbalest and Highwayman.

reasons: Reduces melee critical strike chance by 3%.
Lowers overall critical hit frequency and stress-relief procs.
notes: Hurts melee strikers relying on crits like Hellion and Bounty Hunter.

reasons: Reduces damage by 15% during the first round of combat.
Dampens opening turn burst when fast enemy kills are most crucial.
notes: Significant handicap on alpha-strike party setups.

reasons: Reduces protection (PROT) by 5%.
Increases physical damage taken on frontline tanks.
notes: Directly counteracts PROT stacking on Man-at-Arms, Crusader, and Leper.

reasons: Reduces blight resistance by 10%.
Makes the hero vulnerable to high-damage damage-over-time in the Ruins and Cove.
notes: Can be mitigated with medicinal herbs, but increases consumable strain.

reasons: Reduces bleed resistance by 10%.
Increases vulnerability to severe bleeds in the Warrens, Weald, and Courtyard.
notes: High risk factor during Crimson Court bloodsucker encounters.

reasons: Reduces disease resistance by 10%.
Increases frequency of contracting chronic diseases from beasts and Warrens curios.
notes: Inflates Sanitarium medical treatment costs across a campaign.

reasons: Reduces Death Blow resistance by 10%.
Significantly increases the chance of permanent hero death upon taking damage at Death's Door.
notes: Dangerous gamble when tackling Champion dungeons or bosses.

reasons: Reduces healing skill output by 20%.
Cripples recovery capacity on dedicated healers like Vestal and Occultist.
notes: Critical priority on Vestal/Occultist; negligible on heroes without healing skills.

reasons: Inflicts +5 stress whenever the hero misses an attack.
Missed attacks doubly penalize the party by stalling combat and generating internal stress.
notes: Particularly harmful on low-accuracy heroes like Leper and Crusader.

reasons: Increases stress damage received by 20% while in dungeon hallways.
Most hallway encounters and wandering battles inflict elevated stress.
notes: Substantially accelerates stress accumulation on medium and long expeditions.

reasons: Increases stress damage received by 20% when HP is below 50%.
Triggers a vicious cycle where damaged heroes rapidly gain afflictions.
notes: High risk on frontline heroes who frequently hover around mid-health.

reasons: Increases stress damage received by 20% when torchlight is below 26.
Severe liability during pitch-black runs and Shambler hunting.
notes: Safe to ignore if strictly maintaining radiant light above 75.

reasons: Forces interactions with Fountain curios.
May trigger tainted basins or fountains without Holy Water purification.
notes: Moderate hazard primarily found in the Ruins and Cove.

reasons: Forces interactions with Food curios.
Risks consuming spoiled carcasses, rotting dining tables, and infected meat carts.
notes: High disease risk in the Warrens.

reasons: Forces interactions with Haunted curios.
Interactions frequently cause severe stress damage and negative quirks.
notes: Common in the Weald and Cove.

reasons: Forces interactions with Unholy curios.
Triggers blasphemous altars and cursed statuary without Holy Water.
notes: Moderate priority compared to Dark Temptation.

reasons: Forces interactions with Worship curios.
Triggers altars, shrines, and confession booths blindly.
notes: Risk of receiving debuffs and stress in place of blessings.

reasons: Forces interactions with Worship curios.
Can cause harmful stress and quirk mutations from unpurified holy sites.
notes: Found primarily in the Ruins.

reasons: Forces interactions with Worship curios.
Triggers confession booths and shrines, often causing high stress penalties.
notes: Moderate stress hazard in the Ruins.
